citation.title: Generative Design by Reinforcement Learning: Maximizing Diversity of Topology Optimized Designs
citation.version_coded: arXiv v1 (17 Aug 2020) specifically — this is the version this pool id represents (title 'Maximizing Diversity...', 2 authors). The same arXiv number's later v2 (16 Feb 2021) was retitled 'Enhancing the Diversity of Topology Optimization Designs,' added a third author (Soyoung Yoo), and was published as Computer-Aided Design 146:103225 (2022), doi 10.1016/j.cad.2022.103225 — confirmed via the arXiv abs page's version history and journal-ref. That version is pool id P00158 (per audit/pool/pool.csv title/author/arXiv-id match) and is treated as the primary, non-duplicate record.

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (duplicate). Headline, from the abstract: an RL agent (PPO) is trained to pick topology-optimization design parameters directly, approximating the TO process with a neural network so that many diverse optimized designs can be generated in a short GPU inference time, demonstrated on an automotive wheel design case study, with the text claiming improvement over traditional CPU-based methods requiring human involvement.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded (excluded as a duplicate); a speed/diversity claim exists in the abstract ('short inference time by exploiting GPU', 'improvements over traditional CPU-based methods') but no number is given there and full-text extraction was not performed for this non-primary version.

Per the protocol's primary-version rule (version of record if open access, else the latest arXiv version), P00158 is the primary version either way — it is both the version of record and corresponds to the latest arXiv revision — so P00925 (v1 specifically, superseded before the third author was added and before journal publication) is coded here as the non-primary duplicate. Because full coding belongs on the primary record (P00158, outside this queue), this record was not read further beyond the abstract and version-history metadata needed to establish the duplicate relationship; method_family, physics and dim above are carried from the abstract and general knowledge of this benchmark (RL/PPO generative design on a 2D automotive-wheel topology-optimization case study) and are marked here as inferred, not independently re-verified against the v1 full text.
